# Nightwaves terminology

The station's own words, for a writer who would otherwise miss or misuse them.

| Term      | Use it for                                   |
| --------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| The queue | The user's open tasks, waiting as requests   |
| Dead air  | Silence on the show; a task that slipped     |
| The booth | Where Wren and Basil work; the crew together |
| Sign-off  | The last words of the night; evenings only   |
